book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: The third voyage began like the others.

sentences.ar: بس ريح قوية رمتنا على جزيرة غريبة.
sentences.en: But a strong wind threw us onto a strange island.
Small, hairy people came out at us.
They were many and we did not understand their speech.
They took the ship and threw us on the shore.

sentences.ar: مشينا لجوا الجزيرة وشفنا قصر كبير.
sentences.en: We walked inland and saw a big palace.

sentences.ar: الباب كان مفتوح وما في حدا.
sentences.en: The door was open and there was nobody.
